output.summary: User with IBS-D-type flares triggered by work stress asked what they can do. The bot explained the gut-brain link, suggested gut-directed hypnotherapy and CBT, covered acute options such as antispasmodics and preemptive loperamide, and discussed caffeine and a plan. User said it was more helpful than their doctor's advice and left with things to try and a plan to involve their doctor.
